page_title: ARS 3-1 LIV | Arsenal v Liverpool 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' A pass from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.
90+5' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) picks up a yellow card.
90+4' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.

90+2' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Alisson. 3:1.

90+1' William Saliba (Arsenal) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. This is a yellow card! William Saliba (Arsenal) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Unsporting behaviour by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool). Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
88' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) sees a yellow card in the hand of Anthony Taylor. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is sent from the pitch.
87' The attendance for today's match is 60374.
86' Flag up against Darwin Nunez (Liverpool). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
85' It's time for a substitution. Thiago (Liverpool) comes on in place of Joe Gomez.
85' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar.

84' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
83' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
82' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but David Raya was alert and made a comfortable save.
79' Bukayo Saka is substituted due to injury. Mikel Arteta gives a chance to Reiss Nelson (Arsenal).
79' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
77' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has David Raya scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
77' The corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.
76' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
75' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
74' Substitution. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) on for Gabriel Martinelli.
72' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:8. The shots on goal statistics – 5:1.
69' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.

69' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.

67' 2 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:1.
64' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Arsenal, play can continue.
64' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Arsenal. Let’s see what happens!
63' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
62' The ball is laid off to Luis Diaz (Liverpool) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces David Raya to make a decent save.
61' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
61' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner.
61' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
59' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
58' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
58' Substitution. Ryan Gravenberch will be replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
58' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) replaces Cody Gakpo.
58' The substitution is prepared. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Trent Alexander-Arnold.
57' Gabriel (Arsenal) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
56' Martin Odegaard finds the head of Gabriel (Arsenal) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies past the right post. Unlucky!
55' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
54' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) brought his opponent down.
53' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

52' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
51' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a long ball forward to Gabriel Martinelli, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball has crossed the sideline. Liverpool are taking a throw-in.
48' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
47' A pass by Luis Diaz (Liverpool) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' A thunderous effort from long range by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) goes well wide of the left post.
46' A first-time shot by Luis Diaz (Liverpool) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
46' Half-time substitution. Mikel Arteta decided to make a change. Oleksandr Zinchenko is replaced by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).
46' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' 1 - 1 This is definitely not what Gabriel (Arsenal) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:1.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Ben White (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
43' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
41' A pass from Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.
39' Declan Rice (Arsenal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

38' Gabriel (Arsenal) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Alisson pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.
37' Poor challenge! Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Arsenal have a free kick.
36' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alisson, who smothers the ball.

31' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Ben White (Arsenal). Ben White (Arsenal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
30' 4:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
29' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Trent Alexander-Arnold, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar.
28' There's an opportunity for Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
28' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
28' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
25' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) picks up a yellow card.
24' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
23' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal).
21' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' Declan Rice (Arsenal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Liverpool players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
14' 1 - 0 Kai Havertz fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) inside the box and he sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
13' Fine attempt! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
11' Lovely cross from Gabriel Martinelli to find Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) deep in the box, but he steers his header well wide of the right post.
11' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is caught offside once again.
7' Arsenal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
2' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' Wonderful pass from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) for Diogo Jota, but they can't profit from it as David Raya comes off his line to collect.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
